text:
kyle: heads-up — ap-southeast1 saw a metadata-journal rollover during a blockmap rotation on local NVMe. IOPS spiked and a subset of GPU attach ops were delayed/failed. seeing CRC chatter in kernel logs.
storage-bot: [ALERT] blockmap-rotation::ap-southeast1 iops_spike=4900->18000 attach_failures=12 window=6m
mona: how widespread? which pools/nodes impacted?
kyle: rough scope: ~120 nodes in scratchpool-2. attach backlog peaked ~30s, some jobs auto-requeued. Not a full device corruption but ~6 devices reported metadata mismatch flags. dmesg excerpt:```
nvme0n1: metadata checksum mismatch at LBA 0x1a3f4 journal-reset
blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 1234567
```
chetan: can we throttle or pause the blockmap rotator? which change caused the aggressiveness?
kyle: rotator v1.3 triggered when free-block-frag >72%. We rolled a config tweak yesterday that increased migration aggressiveness (lowered thresholds).
ingrid: proposal: pause the rotator for ap-southeast1, revert the aggressiveness change, and temporarily steer new GPU provisioning to us-west1 for ~1h. tradeoff: ~+12% cross-region egress for the window but keeps attach SLAs. ok?
mona: +1 for pause. @ops-oncall can you hold the cron and set throttles?
ops-oncall: done — cron `blockmap-rotator` paused in ap-southeast1. set `gc_throttle=0.2` cluster-wide for scratchpool-2.
kyle: confirmed. kicking a light compaction run on flagged nodes now:`for n in $(cat flagged); do ssh $n sudo nvme compaction --light; done`
storage-bot: compaction jobs queued=120 nodes estimate=45m at current throttle (0.2)
chetan: also add a temporary region preference change in autoscaler so new GPU requests prefer us-west1/us-central: `region_preference: ["us-west1","us-central1"]`
ingrid: enabling fallback model routing for low-priority batches so they don't pile up. set rollout to 100% fallback.
mona: set a watch on attach latency p95, alert if >10s.
kyle: monitoring dashboards now. will post a status in 20m with node-level health and any devices needing manual scrub.
mona: keep updates brief here. only essential signals.
kyle: 20m update — compaction at ~40%, IOPS returned to baseline, attach failures -> 0 in last 10m. still 3 nodes flagged with persistent metadata-mismatch that need manual full-scrub.
chetan: plan for flagged nodes: cordon + nvme reset + full scrub during a maintenance window: `ssh $n sudo nvme reset && sudo scrub --full /dev/nvme0n1`
ingrid: cost note: reroute + cross-region preference added ~0.9% to infra spend in the last 20m. filing PM for cost impact tracking.
mona: opening postmortem ticket and assigning owners for actions: revert rotator config, improve rotator safety (circuit-breaker), add preflight checks, and add a regional drain flow for provisioning. :memo:
kyle: logged node list and will follow up with a PR to revert the rotator aggressiveness change and a canary plan for v1.4.
